summary: Verified interactive draft cards feature in UnifiedBotWidget. When user enters create command 'انشى عمليه بيع قطعه قلب هاي من قطع راكان على ماجد العنزي' in فوري tab, the bot correctly: (1) auto-switches to إنشاء tab, (2) displays interactive-draft-cards with type/partner/amount cards, (3) shows missing field chips (المبلغ, المركبة), (4) displays action buttons (تأكيد الآن/تعديل الحقول/إلغاء), (5) shows vehicle candidates section with add new vehicle button, (6) does NOT show report/statement phrases.
critical_code_review_comments: interactiveDraft state correctly populated with templateId, templateLabel, amount, partnerName, missing fields, and vehicleCandidates
parseCreateIntent correctly extracts partner name from 'على ماجد العنزي' pattern
findVehiclesForPartner searches vehicles by normalized customer name
Action buttons (confirm/edit/cancel) work correctly with proper state updates
Vehicle candidates section shows 'لا توجد مركبات مطابقة بالاسم' when no matches found + add new vehicle button
context_for_next_testing_agent: Interactive draft cards feature fully verified. All data-testid attributes present and working: interactive-draft-cards, draft-card-type, draft-card-partner, draft-card-amount, draft-missing-chips, draft-missing-*, draft-action-buttons, draft-action-confirm, draft-action-edit, draft-action-cancel, draft-vehicle-candidates, draft-add-new-vehicle.

auto_tab_switch.description: Command in فوري tab auto-switches to إنشاء tab

interactive_draft_cards.description: interactive-draft-cards container visible with معاينة تفاعلية قبل التأكيد header

draft_card_partner.description: Shows 'الطرف: ماجد العنزي' correctly extracted from command

draft_card_amount.description: Shows 'المبلغ: غير محدد' when no amount in command

draft_missing_chips.description: Shows clickable chips for missing fields: المبلغ, المركبة

draft_action_buttons.description: Shows 3 action buttons: تأكيد الآن, تعديل الحقول, إلغاء

draft_vehicle_candidates.description: Shows vehicle candidates section with 'مركبات العميل المطابقة' header

no_report_phrases.description: Response does NOT contain تقرير/كشف/رصيد phrases

edit_button_action.description: Edit button shows message 'يمكنك تعديل الحقول ثم الضغط على التنفيذ'
